I estimated the plate at roughly 26 cm across, which is only a guess because the plate is cropped in the photo. The diced chicken covers about a 12 x 10 cm patch on the right side of the plate. Its layer is about 1.5–2 cm thick, so I put it at roughly 110 g. Cooked chicken breast runs about 165 kcal per 100 g. Only a few cherry tomatoes are partly visible at the bottom edge, probably 2–3 of them at about 15 g each, so I estimated 40 g in total. I could not see any oil or sauce.
